text_description: Full-length lower-body runway view of a model walking in a vivid green dress or coordinated skirted look, cropped at the upper torso so the neckline is not visible. The visible garment is close-cut through the waist and hips, with bold black graphic curved bands and angular appliqué-like shapes wrapping across the green surface, including a thick black curve at the left hip and a diagonal black line near the upper skirt. The skirt falls to around the knee with a fluid, slightly flared silhouette, vertical pleat-like folds, and an uneven softly moving hem that opens higher at the center front as the legs cross in stride. The model carries a light cream coat or jacket draped over the left hand, hanging long beside the body, along with a small dark brown/black drawstring bucket-style handbag suspended from long thin straps. Footwear is a pair of black low-cut pumps with rounded toes accented by prominent textured gold toe caps or ornaments. The styling reads polished and graphic, combining saturated green, stark black patterning, cream outerwear, and metallic gold shoe details.
